prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Back in 2025 I was in Shanghai for work and I remember just scrolling through rental car options there to kill time.
Funny thing is, on that same trip I kept comparing it to Beijing, because earlier I’d also been checking what parking was like around Beijing.
My coworker told me he ended up with a Toyota Corolla under the name John Smith, but it was all already handled before I even saw the details.
And yeah, that Corolla pickup date was 2025-03-15, and he kept it for 4 days—he was complaining about the paperwork the whole time.

Later that spring he also mentioned he’d already set up parking at China World Trade Center Parking starting 2025-04-25 12:00 for 12 hours, plate 浙E34567, and the contact number on it was 13811223344.
